items.text: Jets ruled out RB Breece Hall (quad) and WR Adonai Mitchell for Sunday vs. Bears.
items.why: Quad injury from prior week; no practice.
items.implication: Jets backfield to Braelon Allen lead + Isaiah Davis; Hall misses at least this game.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for backup RBs vs CHI.

items.text: Commanders QB Jayden Daniels officially out Sunday; Marcus Mariota starts again vs Colts in London.
items.why: Elbow dislocation recovery; practiced limited with brace but not ready.
items.implication: Mariota starts second straight; Daniels likely Week 5 candidate after full practice week.
items.opportunity: Commanders pass catchers (McLaurin/Samuel if active) with veteran QB; Colts defense soft vs pass.

items.text: Saints placing RB Travis Etienne on IR due to hamstring injury.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated Week 3; no surgery but min 4 weeks.
items.implication: Misses at least 4 games; Kamara/Miller/Donaldson committee.
items.opportunity: Elevated snaps/carries/targets for Alvin Kamara and Kendre Miller.

items.text: With Dylan Sampson (knee) out virtually all season, Quinshon Judkins has 13.8% target share (vs 8.3% prior); on pace for 64 catches after 26 last year. Only 4-game sample.
items.why: Teammate absence boosting receiving role; recent high targets (e.g. 7 vs PIT).
items.implication: Volume RB2 with pass-game juice; pace implies sustained receiving upside.
items.opportunity: Elevated target share/routes while Sampson sidelined.

items.text: Little optimism DeVonta Smith (hamstring) plays vs Rams; Rams get Puka Nacua back.
items.why: Sources: Smith sidelined all week, expectation out; Nacua returning.
items.implication: Eagles WR depth (Brown/Goedert) boost; Nacua full role for LAR.
items.opportunity: Nacua snaps/targets return; Eagles targets consolidate.

items.text: LOVE Jaylen Warren @ CLE (TNF): led all RBs 90% snaps last week, 20/22 RB touches with Dowdle out; CLE allows 88+ rush yds every game. Full workhorse.
items.why: Elite snap/touch share + favorable matchup; Dowdle out again.
items.implication: Top-10 RB play this week; start confidently.

items.text: LOVE Drake London @ NO: 35% career target share/104 ypg with Penix; 43.5% share last week (9-194); NO allows 5th-most WR TDs.
items.why: Penix chemistry + volume spike + soft WR matchup.

items.text: LOVE Garrett Wilson @ CHI: Mitchell likely out again; prior 36% target share without him; 78% catch rate, CHI allows 14+ ypr.
Fresh ETR ROS Top-150: Kenneth Walker ranked 3 overall (notable high); also Parker Washington 22, Saquon Barkley 30. Rankings/trade calc updated for injuries/roles.
items.why: Factored injuries, schedule, role info; Walker elite ROS.
items.implication: Strong hold/trade-up target; high trade value.

items.text: LOVE Josh Downs vs WSH: 31% target share last two, 43% red-zone looks; WAS allows most WR fantasy pts and slot TDs.
LOVE George Kittle vs DEN: target share/routes climbing (27% Wk3); Evans day-to-day ribs; DEN 8th-most TE yards allowed.
items.why: Rising usage + potential teammate absence + matchup.

items.text: HATE Justin Herbert @ SEA: 44% pressure rate this year, SEA 4th pressure/lowest YPA/YPC; Chargers bottom-3 implied total.
items.why: Pressure + tough secondary + low team total.

items.text: HATE Omarion Hampton @ SEA: RB27 util, 3.5% tgt/25% routes, snaps down to 42% Wk3 (13% 3rd down); SEA 2.9 YPC allowed (2nd-fewest).
items.why: Poor usage profile + elite run defense matchup.

items.text: HATE Kyle Pitts @ NO: 16% career tgt share/34 ypg with Penix; under 8 pts in 9/13 such games; TE37 util this year.
items.why: Persistent low usage/aDOT with Penix; Levitan notes similar underperformance.
